traits.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), order 77 Solanales (Solanaceae, Convolvulaceae and kin): mostly herbs or twiners; leaves alternate; no stipules; corolla regular (a few nightshades irregular); stamens as many as the corolla lobes and alternate with them; ovary superior, often of two cells.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Solanaceae leaves alternate, usually spiral; Convolvulaceae alternate, spiral. APweb Solanales page: Sphenocleaceae spirally arranged. Montiniaceae (opposite in part) is the only exception.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Solanales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): inflorescence terminal. Flora of China Solanaceae: mostly terminal but often looking axillary, extra-axillary or leaf-opposed after sympodial growth, so a drawing may read these as lateral. Convolvulaceae differ (override).

traits.life_span.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Solanaceae annual, biennial or perennial, many shrubs and trees; Convolvulaceae mostly climbing herbs plus shrubs and lianas. Wikipedia Ipomoea: annual or perennial. 'Usually perennial' inferred from the woody and perennial bulk.

traits.leaf_division.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Solanaceae simple or compound (ternate or pinnate); Convolvulaceae entire or lobed; Wikipedia Convolvulaceae: leaves simple.

traits.division_pattern.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Solanaceae compound leaves ternate or pinnate (tomato, potato pinnate); Convolvulaceae divided leaves pinnatifid or palmatifid.

traits.inflorescence.note: DELTA Convolvulaceae (read 2026-10-16): flowers solitary or in cymes (dichasia or cincinni); APweb Solanales page: Convolvulaceae cymose, Sphenoclea in dense spikes. Solanaceae states cyme/solitary.

traits.hypanthium.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Solanaceae and Convolvulaceae with a hypogynous disk, no hypanthium; every family states false.

traits.sexual_system.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Convolvulaceae usually hermaphrodite (dioecious in Hildebrandtia); Solanaceae flowers bisexual. Montiniaceae dioecious (states its own).

traits.rosette.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Convolvulaceae climbing or trailing; Solanaceae herbs to trees, rosettes only in a few herbs (Mandragora type). Inferred.

traits.fruit_type.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Convolvulaceae usually a capsule; Solanaceae berry, capsule or drupe. Capsule first by species weight (Convolvulaceae plus capsular Solanaceae such as Nicotiana, Petunia, Datura); inferred.
